import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:isolate';

import 'package:adele_contract/adele_contract.dart';

import 'prepared_capability_contract.dart';

const _bound = Duration(seconds: 10);

Future<void> main(List<String> arguments, Object? bootstrapMessage) async {
  final bootstrap = bootstrapMessage! as Map;
  final responses = bootstrap['responsePort'] as SendPort;
  final options = jsonDecode(arguments.single) as Map;
  final probe = _Probe(
    options['identity'] as String,
    options['context'] as String,
  );
  final exposure = AdeleCapabilityExposure(
    providerId: options['providerId'] as String,
    capabilityId: 'test.capability.read',
    capabilityMajorVersion: 1,
    serviceId: capabilityProbeServiceId,
    displayName: 'Provider ${probe.identity}',
    configurationContext: probe.configuration,
    rank: options['rank'] as int,
  );
  final router = AdeleConfigurationContextRouter(
    contexts: {
      probe.configuration: {
        capabilityProbeServiceId: CapabilityProbeServiceDispatcher(
          probe,
          concurrent: true,
        ),
        // A routed service is not a public Capability advertisement.
        'test.capability.private': CapabilityProbeServiceDispatcher(probe),
      },
    },
  );
  final commands = ReceivePort();
  (bootstrap['bootstrapPort'] as SendPort).send({
    'kind': 'ready',
    'commandPort': commands.sendPort,
    'pluginBackendProtocolVersion': adelePluginBackendProtocolVersion,
    'capabilityExposures': [exposure.toMap()],
  });
  try {
    await for (final Object? message in commands) {
      if (message is! Map) continue;
      if (message['kind'] == 'request' && message['method'] == 'shutdown') {
        probe.release();
        responses.send({
          'kind': 'response',
          'requestId': message['requestId'],
          'ok': true,
          'payload': {'stopping': true},
        });
        break;
      }
      // Native test synchronization only. The EVC never imports or calls this.
      if (message['kind'] == 'request' && message['serviceId'] == 'probe') {
        if (message['method'] == 'terminate') Isolate.exit();
        unawaited(probe.control(message, responses));
        continue;
      }
      if (message['kind'] == 'request' || message['kind'] == 'streamOpen') {
        if (probe.requests.length >= 64) throw StateError('Request limit.');
        probe.requests.add({
          'configurationContext': message['configurationContext'],
          'serviceId': message['serviceId'],
          'method': message['method'],
          'payload': message['payload'],
          'hostInvocationContext': message['hostInvocationContext'],
        });
      }
      unawaited(router.handle(message, responses.send));
    }
  } finally {
    probe.release();
    commands.close();
    await router.close();
  }
}

final class _Probe implements CapabilityProbeService {
  _Probe(this.identity, this.configuration);

  final String identity;
  final String configuration;
  final requests = <Map<String, Object?>>[];
  final counts = <String, int>{};
  final gates = <String, Map<int, Completer<void>>>{};
  final held = Completer<void>();
  StreamController<ProbeValue>? events;

  void mark(String key) {
    final count = counts.update(key, (value) => value + 1, ifAbsent: () => 1);
    gates[key]?.remove(count)?.complete();
  }

  Future<void> wait(String key, int count) async {
    if (count < 1 || count > 64) throw ArgumentError.value(count);
    if ((counts[key] ?? 0) >= count) return;
    await ((gates[key] ??= {})[count] ??= Completer<void>()).future.timeout(
      _bound,
    );
  }

  void release() {
    if (!held.isCompleted) held.complete();
  }

  ProbeValue value(int sequence, String text) => ProbeValue(
    provider: identity,
    configuration: configuration,
    sequence: sequence,
    text: text,
  );

  @override
  Future<ProbeValue> read(String scope) async {
    mark('read:$scope');
    if (scope == 'held') await held.future.timeout(_bound);
    if (scope == 'fail') throw StateError('SECRET provider failure');
    return value(0, scope);
  }

  @override
  Stream<ProbeValue> watch(String scope) {
    late StreamController<ProbeValue> controller;
    controller = StreamController<ProbeValue>(
      onListen: () {
        mark('watch:$scope');
        if (scope == 'bounded') {
          controller.add(value(1, 'first'));
          controller.add(value(2, 'last'));
          unawaited(controller.close());
        }
        if (scope == 'fail') {
          controller.addError(StateError('SECRET stream failure'));
          unawaited(controller.close());
        }
      },
      onCancel: () => mark('cancel:$scope'),
    );
    events = controller;
    return controller.stream;
  }

  Future<void> control(
    Map<Object?, Object?> request,
    SendPort responses,
  ) async {
    try {
      final payload = request['payload'] as Map;
      final Object? result = switch (request['method']) {
        'snapshot' => {'requests': requests, 'counts': counts},
        'wait' => await wait(
          payload['key'] as String,
          payload['count'] as int,
        ).then((_) => true),
        'release' => (() {
          release();
          return true;
        })(),
        'emit' => (() {
          events!.add(
            value(payload['sequence'] as int, payload['text'] as String),
          );
          return true;
        })(),
        _ => throw StateError('Unknown probe control.'),
      };
      responses.send({
        'kind': 'response',
        'requestId': request['requestId'],
        'ok': true,
        'payload': jsonDecode(jsonEncode(result)),
      });
    } on Object catch (error) {
      responses.send({
        'kind': 'response',
        'requestId': request['requestId'],
        'ok': false,
        'error': {'code': 'probe_control_failed', 'message': '$error'},
      });
    }
  }
}
